title: 375 lbs (165 kg) Nippard shrugs for 15
summary: Lift clip of snatch-grip ('Nippard') shrugs with 375 lbs for 15 reps. The description says they give an excellent trap stretch with minimal lower back strain but tax mid-back stability. The audio is only background music.

claims.claim: Snatch-grip ('Nippard') shrugs give an excellent weighted trap stretch with minimal lower back strain, though they tax mid-back stability quite a bit.

exercises.name: Snatch-grip shrugs (Nippard shrugs)
exercises.why: great trap stretch with little lower back strain
